lean.statement:
∀ {d : ℕ} (hd : 2 ≤ d) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 2 ≤ κ)
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 1 ≤ n) (hnd : n < d),
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let eigenvalue : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => (κ + 1) / 2 + (κ - 1) / 2 * Real.cos (θ i)
  let Λ : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin d) ℝ := Matrix.diagonal eigenvalue
  let μ : Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) :=
    multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)) Λ⁻¹
  let Q : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) → ℝ := fun x =>
    ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i) * (WithLp.ofLp x i) ^ 2
  let M : ℝ := ∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d), ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μ
  MemLp (fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖x‖ ^ 2) 2 μ ∧
  MemLp Q 2 μ ∧
  Var[fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖x‖ ^ 2; μ] =
    2 * ∑ i : Fin d, 1 / (eigenvalue i) ^ 2 ∧
  Var[Q; μ] = 2 * ∑ i : Fin d, (Real.cos ((n : ℝ) * θ i)) ^ 2 / (eigenvalue i) ^ 2 ∧
  Var[fun x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d) => ‖x‖ ^ 2; μ] ≤ 2 * M ∧
  Var[Q; μ] ≤ 2 * M ∧
  2 * M ≤ 2 * (d : ℝ) / Real.sqrt κ
approved_definition_context: Fin d is the usual finite type with values zero through d minus one; all finite sums run over its coordinates.
EuclideanSpace Real (Fin d) has its usual Euclidean norm; WithLp.ofLp exposes coordinates. Matrix.diagonal is the usual diagonal matrix.

ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian m S is the image of the standard Gaussian by x↦m+toEuclideanCLM(CFC.sqrt S)x. The matrix is covariance on the positive semidefinite domain; the standard totalized square root is zero outside that domain.

Real and matrix inverses are standard totalized inverses. All displayed integrals are real Bochner integrals. MemLp f 2 μ means actual square integrability, including almost-everywhere strong measurability.

Var[f;μ] means standard real variance: the extended integral of the squared centered real norm, followed by ENNReal.toReal. That map sends infinity to zero; the explicit MemLp conclusions establish finite variance for these observables.
Natural powers, square root, cosine, pi, real casts and finite sums have their standard meanings.
